# The White Swan, Henley-in-Arden

> A 16th-century coaching inn on Henley-in-Arden High Street. Historic rooms, homemade pub food, live music on Fridays, and an inn on this site since 1352.

The White Swan is a hotel, bar and restaurant at 100 High Street, Henley-in-Arden, Warwickshire B95 5BY. Open Monday to Sunday, 12pm to 11pm. Phone 01564 660 303. Email whiteswan@westbourne.co.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.thewhiteswanhenley.co.uk/): rooms and booking, food and drink, what's on, private hire, and how to find us
- [Our story](https://www.thewhiteswanhenley.co.uk/history/): the history of the White Swan, from 1352 to today
